The types of vehicle travelling on a road were recorded.
The table shows the results for a sample of 200 vehicles.

| Type of vehicle | Car | Van | Truck | Motorcycle |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Number of vehicles | 84 | 64 | 40 | 12 |
| Relative frequency | | | | |

Complete the table.

One day 5000 vehicles use the road.
Work out an estimate for the number of trucks that use the road that day.

Write down the mathematical name for this quadrilateral.

In the diagram, angle $ABC = 90^\circ$.
$AB = BC$ and $AC = 10\text{ cm}$.
Calculate the area of triangle $ABC$.

[3]

Samina has two pieces of string.
The lengths of the two pieces of string are in the ratio $5 : 3$.
Samina cuts $4\text{ cm}$ off each piece of string.
The lengths of the two remaining pieces of string are in the ratio $2 : 1$.
Find the original lengths of Samina's pieces of string.

Find the probability that both numbers are in $(A \cup B)' \cap C$.
